show.description:
Raj is a simple janitor and a caring father, but secretly he is the powerful and mysterious “Raja Sahib,” feared by criminals and respected by the biggest business leaders.

When rich businesswoman Sara falls in love with him, Raj hides his true identity while protecting his family from dangerous enemies and underworld threats.

But one day, the world discovers that the poor man they insulted is actually the most powerful man in the room
